lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {Village} sits at the far edge of the {empire}, where the roads give out and the forest begins.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody comes here on purpose. That is why {mc} stayed.

lines.speaker: villager
lines.text: {mc}! There's a woman on the north road. She's bleeding through her cloak.

lines.speaker: villager
lines.text: Worse, I think. She came out of the trees at a run, and she won't stop for anyone.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Get indoors, all of you. They are close behind me.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Imperial hunters. Eight when I left the pass. Six now.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: I can stand long enough. Can you hold a blade?

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: This is my home. I won't hide in it.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Then stay at my side, and keep your feet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Torches move between the trees. A horn sounds, close and low.
